Problem.Title: You have a job to do.
Problem.Subtitle: Not software to learn. The market offers tools designed for large teams — not for small businesses that keep the real economy running.

Problem.Items.Title: Too expensive
Problem.Items.Description: Subscriptions designed for 50-person teams, billed to someone working alone or in a pair.

Problem.Items.Title: Too complex
Problem.Items.Description: Interfaces with 200 options to do one single thing. The learning curve takes weeks. You give up after two days.

Problem.Items.Title: Too intimidating
Problem.Items.Description: Dashboards designed for product managers, not for a craftsperson tracking quotes or a bar owner checking stock.

Problem.Items.Title: Full of useless stuff
Problem.Items.Description: 90% of features will never be used. But they're there, cluttering the screen, slowing everything down.

Vision.Title: What we believe in
Vision.Manifesto:
The best software is the kind you forget you're using.

We build the 10% of features that generate 90% of the value. Tools you understand in 5 minutes, without training. Prices accessible to those running their business alone or in a small team.

No intimidating interfaces. No features buried in endless menus. Just the essentials — available immediately, useful from day one.

BackLab is calm software. For real people, with real jobs.
Products.Title: Our products
Products.Subtitle: Each BackLab tool solves one precise problem, for one precise kind of business. Nothing more.

Products.Items.Name: BackBoost
Products.Items.Tagline: Recover forgotten quotes. Stop losing revenue.
Products.Items.Description: Every quote without a follow-up is money walking out the door. BackBoost automates your follow-ups and gives you a clear view of your sales pipeline — without you having to think about it.

Products.Items.Name: BackCall
Products.Items.Tagline: A missed call shouldn't become a lost customer.
Products.Items.Description: Every unanswered call goes to your competitor. BackCall notifies you who called and helps you reach back quickly — from your phone, in two taps.

Products.Items.Name: BackReview
Products.Items.Tagline: Satisfied customers should spread the word. Easily.
Products.Items.Description: Online reviews build your local reputation. BackReview automatically sends a review invitation to customers right after their visit — without you having to ask.

Products.Items.Name: BackFill
Products.Items.Tagline: An empty slot is lost revenue. Fill it.
Products.Items.Description: BackFill identifies your free slots and intelligently offers them to your clients — by SMS or notification. No more gaps in your calendar, no more unpaid downtime.

Products.Items.Name: BackBar
Products.Items.Tagline: Run your bar without an ERP. Just what you need.
Products.Items.Description: Stock, margins, restocking — BackBar gives you the clear view you need to run your business, without the complexity of an 800€/month system.

Founder.Title: The person behind BackLab
Founder.Name: Mathilde Fauveau
Founder.Role: Founder · Developer · Web designer · Web copywriter
Founder.Paragraphs: BackLab was born from a concrete frustration: too many small businesses give up on digital because the available tools are built for large companies — too expensive, too complex, too intimidating.

I combine three skills that rarely go together: I code, I design, and I write. That means when I work on your project, you have one person — not three freelancers coordinating badly and billing separately.
My bet with BackLab: build the tools I wished existed. And when an off-the-shelf solution isn't enough — I build exactly what you need. Pragmatic, useful, immediately.
FAQ.Title: Frequently asked questions

FAQ.Items.Question: Do I need to be comfortable with technology?
FAQ.Items.Answer: No. If you can use WhatsApp or check your email, you can use BackLab. Our tools are designed to be understood in under 5 minutes, with no training. That's our commitment.

FAQ.Items.Question: Are the products already available?
FAQ.Items.Answer: They're in active development. We're opening access progressively to selected businesses to test and refine each tool. Join the waiting list to be among the first — with launch pricing.

FAQ.Items.Question: Can I join a waiting list?
FAQ.Items.Answer: Yes, and it's the best thing to do right now. Contact us by email with your business type and need. Waiting list members get preferential pricing and priority access.

FAQ.Items.Question: Do you work on custom projects?
FAQ.Items.Answer: Yes, in targeted cases. If your need is concrete and simple, and none of our products cover it exactly, we can discuss a solution tailored to your business.

FAQ.Items.Question: What types of businesses do you work with?
FAQ.Items.Answer: Craftspeople, freelancers, micro-entrepreneurs, bar or restaurant owners, hairdressers, garages, small shops — any business of 1 to 15 people that wants to move forward digitally without fighting complicated software.

FAQ.Items.Question: Are your prices adapted to small businesses?
FAQ.Items.Answer: That's the core of our model. Our tools are designed to be affordable for a sole trader. No inflated subscription packed with features you'll never need.

Contact.Title: We respond like humans.
Contact.Content: A question about our products? A concrete project to discuss? Want to join the waiting list? Write to us — we respond within 48h, no Kafkaesque form, no automated follow-up.
